generations.prompt:
ROLE/PURPOSE: production sprite-atlas candidate for an existing French Mass Effect 1 fan RPG using realistic HD prerendered 2D characters in an orthographic 3D JRPG combat scene.
REFERENCE SUBJECT: Use ONLY the green fungal humanoid in the BOTTOM ROW, THIRD CHARACTER FROM THE LEFT of the supplied enemy atlas (the Thorian creeper prototype). The seven other characters are not subjects for this output. This is an existing prototype identity reference, not a claim to reconstruct every canonical detail.
SUBJECT LOCKS: Exactly the same hunched green-grey fungal humanoid in all four states, long muscular sinewy arms, elongated clawed fingers and toes, pale fibrous torso, mossy olive-green knotted tendrils, round green fungal saccules across shoulders/back, small recessed head under its fungal hood. No clothing, armour, weapon, firearm or mechanical parts. Preserve realistic adult humanoid proportions and the existing detailed surface texture, diffuse upper-left light, restrained palette and soft prerendered edge style.
VIEW: Identical full-body three-quarter orthographic view in every living pose, facing toward image-left, mildly elevated game camera. Side fallen view for the down state, head to image-left. All extremities must be complete.
TECHNICAL OUTPUT: One native 1536 by 1024 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT background, arranged as a spacious 2 by 2 layout. Exactly four completely separated complete silhouettes. A broad TRANSPARENT horizontal and vertical cross must separate all cells. No silhouette, tendril, finger or toe may cross a cell boundary. Each silhouette must have at least 30 pixels of clear transparent margin on every side. Fit living subjects about 380 pixels high within their 768 by 512 cell, leaving empty space rather than enlarging the figure. Ground support stays on a consistent lower line in each living cell.
POSE ORDER:
TOP LEFT = aim: organic alert/readiness stance, hunched with claws ready; this creature has no gun.
TOP RIGHT = power: anticipation/strike pose for the existing organic melee attack, reaching one clawed arm forward toward image-left with its torso turned slightly; NO magic, biotics, glow, acid, projectile, smoke or effects.
BOTTOM LEFT = hit: a clear restrained recoil/impact body pose, same body volume and fungal nodules, head and claws still fully visible.
BOTTOM RIGHT = down: the same complete creature lying inert horizontally on its side, head image-left and feet image-right, all arms/fingers/toes and nodules inside the cell, enough transparent separation from the other figures.
GAME-SCALE READ: distinct posture changes with stable anatomy, fungal silhouette, coherent green-grey values and crisp readable extremities. These are four fixed drawings, not a smooth movement cycle.
EXCLUDE: every other creature in the reference, duplicate extra creatures, separate loose body parts, detached debris, text, numbers, labels, cell borders, scenery, opaque ground, cast shadows outside the body, checkerboard, contact sheet chrome, signatures and watermarks. Do not crop, overlap, merge, or touch any bodies.
generations.reason: Four distinct full silhouettes with disjoint padded rectangles; one isolated visible native pixel lies inside its own power frame and is retained unchanged.
